summary: The MaintAltUsers file is part of the HSPnet application and is responsible for managing alternate user logins. It involves a web page and associated server-side logic for displaying, editing, and managing alternate logins for users.
purpose: To provide a user interface for maintaining alternate logins, allowing the creation, editing, and deletion of alternate login entries for users within the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Manage Alternate User Logins
steps: View a list of alternate user logins.
Add a new alternate login using the provided form.

business_rules: Only system administrators can edit alternate logins.
Alternate logins must be unique for a user.
validations: Mandatory fields such as Alternate_Login must be specified.
Valid user ID and alternate user ID should be provided.
conditions: Screen is editable only if the user is a system administrator.
system_behavior: On page load, setup page and validate URL hash.
Populate details in the form when editing.
Use AJAX controls to dynamically update sections without full page reload.
exceptions: Show error panel for any errors encountered in operations.
